### ST-026

**VCS adapter contract and normalized ChangeSet**

*As a **plugin author**, I want **a provider-neutral change model with explicit completeness**, so that **the impact engine never depends on Git specifics**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S1 | D01, §7.3, §7.4 | [ST-009](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-009) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `ChangeSet` supports added/modified/deleted/renamed with optional ranges and hashes
- [x] `completeness` is mandatory; partial results carry warnings
- [x] Revision refs are provider-scoped and cannot be compared across providers

---

### ST-027

**Git branch and commit comparison**

*As a **developer**, I want **`--base main` and commit-range comparisons**, so that **I can test exactly what my branch changes**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S1 | D02, D03, §7.5 | [ST-026](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-026), [ST-024](DET-project-detection.md#st-024) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `--base <ref>` compares against the merge-base by default; `--base-mode=direct` compares directly
- [x] Changed line ranges are produced for modified files
- [x] Shallow clones without the base produce a clear error with a fetch hint (exit 4)

---

### ST-028

**Git staged, uncommitted and untracked changes**

*As a **developer**, I want **`--staged` and `--uncommitted` modes**, so that **I get fast feedback before committing**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S2 | D04, §7.5 | [ST-027](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-027) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `--staged` uses the index only; `--uncommitted` includes working tree + untracked (respecting .gitignore)
- [x] Binary files are reported but not parsed
- [x] Results are identical to `git diff` on the fixture scenarios

---

### ST-029

**Git renames, deletions, worktrees and nested repos**

*As a **developer**, I want **renames and deletions handled correctly in all repo shapes**, so that **moved code doesn't look like brand-new code**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S2 | D05, §7.5 | [ST-027](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-027) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Renames carry `previousPath`; deletions mark dependent tests as affected
- [x] Works from a linked worktree and inside a monorepo sub-package
- [x] Nested repositories are not silently mixed; each boundary is reported

---

### ST-030

**Native snapshot baseline and content fingerprints**

*As a **developer without version control**, I want **SmartTest to track changes using its own snapshots**, so that **intelligent selection works in any folder**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 8 | S2 | D06, D07, §8 | [ST-026](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-026), [ST-013](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-013) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `snapshot create` stores content hashes (not copies by default) under `.smarttest/state/`
- [x] Incremental fingerprinting uses mtime+size pre-checks and content hashes to confirm
- [x] Rename detection by content hash for unchanged files
- [x] Snapshots are deduplicated and never copy the whole repository

---

### ST-031

**Snapshot comparison with completeness reporting**

*As a **developer**, I want **to diff the working tree against a snapshot**, so that **I see exactly what changed since my last verified run**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S3 | D08, §8.7 | [ST-030](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-030) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `snapshot diff [id]` produces a normalized ChangeSet
- [x] When content is not stored, changed ranges are reported as unknown and completeness = partial
- [x] A snapshot is labelled 'verified baseline' only when linked to execution evidence

### ST-032

**Hybrid mode: Git + native snapshots**

*As a **developer**, I want **Git revisions plus native snapshots for local incremental analysis**, so that **repeated local runs are fast between commits**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Should | 3 | S3 | D09, §8.5 | [ST-031](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-031), [ST-028](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-028) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] In hybrid mode, local runs diff against the last snapshot; `--base` diffs against Git
- [x] Snapshot ids are never treated as Git commits
- [x] Mode is visible in `vcs status`

### ST-034

**Snapshot retention and prune**

*As a **developer**, I want **old snapshots pruned by a retention policy**, so that **`.smarttest/` doesn't grow without bounds**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Should | 2 | S10 | D14, §8.4 | [ST-033](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-033) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `snapshot prune` honours `keep`/`maxAge` config and never deletes verified baselines without `--force`
- [x] Dry-run lists what would be removed
- [x] Prune is safe to interrupt
